verdict.rationale: Docs describe cloud/remote sessions (browser, mobile, teleport) that can kick off long-running tasks, plan and write code across files, verify it works, and then open PRs for review — effectively an end-to-end build-test-review loop (claude-code-docs-26, docs-14, docs-9, docs-10, docs-2, docs-28, docs-3, docs-13). However there's no explicit 'demo' artifact (e.g., preview link, screenshot, or live walkthrough) beyond diff/PR review, and community reports raise reliability concerns about autonomous task completion quality (claude-code-comm-9, claude-code-comm-12), which tempers confidence without concretely disproving the cloud build/test/PR workflow. missing for 10: dedicated demo/preview generation feature, independent hands-on confirmation of successful end-to-end cloud runs.
